name: web-fatis-product-details-and-build-your-bundle-pages
title: Fati's product details page and 'Build Your Bundle' box builder with explanations
whatItIs: Two tall page frames on beige: a product page (donut photo, rating, size chips, quantity and 'Add to cart', 'You may also like' cards) and a bundle page where you pick 8/12/24 pieces and fill an empty-slot grid, each with pink explanatory text and a big 'Fati's' script footer.
whatItMeans: Helpful and on-brand; the empty slot grid makes building a box feel like a game.
techniques: Show a box builder as empty slots that fill up.
Offer size chips for pack quantity.
End every page with an oversized logo footer.

vocabulary.definition: A tool for assembling a custom set of items.
A placeholder showing space still to fill.
